# Pothole Bengaluru

> Crowdsourced pothole reporting and resolution tracking for Bengaluru. Citizens report potholes to BBMP, track repair status on a live city map, and prioritize fixes with AI severity analysis and community votes.

## Pages
- [Live pothole map](/): Interactive map of all reported potholes across Bengaluru with filters by area, ward, status, and severity.
- [Report a pothole](/report): Submit a pothole with photos, AI severity analysis, GPS location, and details. Guest reporting supported.

## Optional
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of public pages.
